task.title: all-cards.spec :339 and :904 are dead from fixture drift
task.description: Found during WB-01M0AWAM8Z (2026-08-20), now deterministic rather than order-sensitive: (1) all-cards.spec.ts:339 'location summary expands' — GET /api/all_cards?q= returns 50 rows with ZERO multi-location cards, so the test fails before rendering (the e2e-suite skill's 'all-cards :270 location summary' fixture-pool item). (2) all-cards.spec.ts:904 (P6-020's mobile test) — needs a catalog card the dev account owns nowhere, but the account now owns all 100 q=z candidates; its base control fails pre-load. The 390px invariant it guarded is re-covered by the new width tests from WB-01M0AWAM8Z. Restoring both needs fixture decisions (multi-location seeds; unowned-card reservation), tied to the fixture-pool task WB-01KZMVA2Y1 and teardown task WB-01M0EF3WN2.
